summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback information provided to the Australian Securities Exchange (ASX) under its $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing confirms the company continues to repurchase its Class A and Class B common stock from time to time. No specific share quantities, prices, or transaction dates were included in the exhibit text. The company notes it will also disclose repurchase activity in quarterly and annual reports. Forward-looking statements regarding buyback intentions are included. What to watch: ongoing repurchase pace and potential impact on share price.
